style: Painterly modern fantasy mobile game art, rich saturated colors, soft rim lighting, crisp clean edges.

styles.toon: Chunky cute cartoon proportions with a big head and small body, bold clean shapes, thin dark outline, painterly shading, modern mobile game character art. Seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right.
styles.bug: Detailed semi-realistic painterly insect illustration with glossy highlights, natural anatomy, game sprite quality. Seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, body perfectly horizontal and level, as if hovering in flight.
styles.boss: Detailed semi-realistic painterly fantasy creature, dramatic lighting, imposing, game boss sprite quality. Seen from the side, facing right.
styles.scene: Painterly modern fantasy mobile game background art, rich colors, soft atmospheric light, depth and haze. No characters, no creatures, no foreground platforms, no text, no UI.
styles.prop: Painterly modern fantasy mobile game asset, clean readable silhouette, soft lighting, seen from the side.
